text:
Maya: Quick check — noticed SM% on pool-3 is up and KV cache evictions spiked ~10% in the last hour. Where's the canonical dash/traces for this? :eyes:
Sahil: hmm, do you mean the heatmap or the per-pool panels?
Maya: heatmap first, then per-pool traces. I grabbed a screenshot but want the links so I can paste in the incident ticket.
Sahil: GPU / Pool heatmap is `GPU / Pool Utilization` in Grafana. Panel id 342. Link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/gpu-pools/gpu-utilization?orgId=1&panelId=342
Sahil: for kvcache evictions the per-pool KV dashboard is `Serving / KV Cache` (panel id 87).
Maya: thanks. Any quick trace query to find which model or request pattern triggered the evictions?
Olivia: try traces filtered by pool + high kv_eviction_rate tag. Example Jaeger query: `service=runtime AND tag.pool=pool-3 AND kv_eviction_rate>0.01`
Olivia: also look at tail latency bursts around the same timestamps.
Maya: copying sample prom query for the ticket:
```
sum(rate(runtime_kv_evictions_total{pool="pool-3"}[5m])) by (model)
```
Kevin: nice. Who owns the kvcache-evict alert right now? I thought it was in the alerts board under `runtime-kv` but owner might be stale.
runtime-bot: Alert fired: `runtime_kv_eviction_rate_high` -> pool=pool-3, severity=warning, value=0.012 (threshold=0.01)
Maya: runtime-bot posted the alert. @Kevin can you take a look at the alert threshold?Seems noisy at current setting.
Kevin: on it. I'll check the alert history and open a PR to bump threshold or add a suppression window. Will post proposed thresholds here in ~30m.
Sahil: if you change threshold please keep an eye on SM% correlation — increasing threshold could hide real regressions. Maybe add a 5min sustained condition instead.
Olivia: agree. Also consider adding a per-model dimension so noisy eval jobs don't trigger org-wide alerts.
Maya: FYI the spike started around 2148008400, attaching the screenshot to the ticket.
Kevin: noted. I'll pull traces for 2148008200-2148009000 and post links.
Maya: thanks all. If Kevin needs extra eyes on the PR ping me — I can check the alert runbook bits. :thumbsup:
